name: Trajectory: managed Mac stopped reporting
message:
{{#is_no_data}}The managed Mac with device ID {{[trajectory.device_id].name}} has sent no Trajectory heartbeat for 3 days.{{/is_no_data}}

The device ID is the Mac's hardware UUID. Jamf Pro shows it as the UDID. A Mac that is shut down, offline, or retired also alerts. Datadog drops the alert about a day later, and tracks the Mac again when it reports.

On the Mac, run this command as the signed-in user, and read `reason` and `next_step`:

`~/.trajectory/bin/trajectory managed status --scope all --format json`

Add the people or channel to notify to this message.
